d: A small, bipedal dragon-like creature with golden-orange scales, featuring a rounded body and thick, chunky limbs. It has a wide, joyful expression with closed, crescent-shaped eyes and a small open mouth. The creature wears a draped, olive-green hooded cloak with golden embroidery and a brown tunic underneath. Visible accessories include a pair of large, curved maroon horns protruding from the hood and smaller orange horns on the forehead, as well as a thick, scaled tail. BODY COLOR: golden-orange LEGS: plantigrade with large, rounded paws and blunt claws.
